(4 games) | prevseason = [[2019–20 Indian Super League|2019–20]] | nextseason = [[2021–22 Indian Super League|2021–22]] | updated = }} The '''2020–21 Indian Super League season''' was the seventh season of the [[Indian Super League]] (ISL) since its formation and the 25th season of the top division of the [[Indian football league system]]. The season started on 20 November 2020 and ended on 13 March 2021. It was hosted [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind closed doors]] across three venues in [[Goa]] due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]. [[Mumbai City FC|Mumbai City]] won the trophy, having defeated [[Mohun Bagan Super Giant|Mohun Bagan]] in the [[2021 Indian Super League final|final]], and also won the League Winners Shield. Thus, Mumbai City became the first club to win, both, the ISL trophy, and League Winners Shield, within the same season.{{cite news |title=Mumbai City FC beat ATK Mohun Bagan FC in Hero ISL 2020-21/final to clinch their first ever title|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/football/indian-super-league/top-stories/mumbai-city-fc-win-maiden-isl-title-beat-atk-mohun-bagan-2-1/articleshow/81486858.cms}} ==Changes from last season== *Each club had the option of signing a minimum of five and a maximum of seven foreign players.
